sectorLayer.title: Semiconductors
sectorLayer.fact: Zhitong reported SMIC (00981.HK) rose as much as 6.23% after its plan to acquire the remaining 49% of SMIC Beijing North was highlighted.
sectorLayer.inference: Inference: investors may view full ownership of an operating wafer-fab asset as supportive of consolidation and earnings attribution.
sectorLayer.keyUncertainty: Completion, timing, financing terms, and regulatory approvals remain material.

sectorLayer.title: AI infrastructure
sectorLayer.fact: Zhitong reported that four large technology companies' 2026 AI capital expenditure is expected to approach US$725 billion.
sectorLayer.inference: Inference: if realised, this would continue to support demand visibility across data-centre, compute, networking and power-supply chains.
sectorLayer.keyUncertainty: The figure is an aggregate expectation and actual spending can change with monetisation, chip supply and macro conditions.
